# Andrew Long

> Senior full stack developer at Mad Genius. Builds web apps, APIs, AI tooling and headless sites with TypeScript, Go and AWS. This site is his portfolio.

- [Process](https://www.idrewlong.com/process/): how he plans, builds and ships projects
- [Blog](https://www.idrewlong.com/blog/): posts about the tools and sites he builds
